description: European Union Interoperability Act assessment report.

id.description: The universally unique ID of the assessment report

uri.description: The canonical URI of the assessment report

name.description: A short name assigned for easy identification.

provider.description:
A public organisation. For an existing organisationm pass its ID. To
create a new organisation pass a `MemberStateOrganisation` object.
It's not possible to to create a new European Union organisation,
you should always pass an ID to refer one. To find out which are all
existing organisations, use the `/organisation` GET resource,
documented in this page.

binding_requirement.description:
One ore multiple objects can be submitted, each following the
BindingRequirement schema.

results_in.description:
Identified effects on cross-border interoperability from different
perspectives: legal, organisational, semantic, and technical.

remaining_barriers.description: Describe possible remaining barriers to interoperability.

documents.description: List of URLs of documents supporting this assessment report.

other_comment.description: Any additional comments or notes about the assessment.
